chronology.observation: Golden pastry rests on the tabletop right of the transparent plastic container and below the eyeglasses; both robot hands are idle and clear. The standing person at right works at a control board.
The lower-right hand rises into view and swings in toward the pastry with the thumb and finger group still open; it reaches the right side of the pastry around frame 54.

Hand positioned beside and over the pastry: the lower grey finger/palm segment slides under and the upper fingers sit above its right side (frame 74 shows pastry still on the table with a gap). Fine positioning adjustments follow, no lift yet.
Fingers close around opposing sides of the pastry (frame 120 shows pincer contact, frame 168 shows it enclosed and starting to rise). No regrasp or second-hand help.
The hand raises the pastry off the table and carries it to the left over the eyeglasses (frames 168-214 near the glasses; frames 216-238 the pastry is above the container's right wall).

Pastry carried across the container rim and lowered into the container; frame 264-290 it hangs inside the container held by the hand, frames 300-334 it sits near the floor, still gripped, with the pastry settling in a slightly tilted position.
The hand opens and releases the pastry onto the container floor; at frame 350 the pastry rests on the container bottom with fingers spread above it.
The hand rises out of the container and withdraws to the right, passing above the eyeglasses and green block (frames 384-408), with the pastry staying in place.

Hand returns near its starting pose at the lower-right edge; pastry rests inside the container through the final frame 444. The standing person looks toward the camera at the end without touching anything.
